title: PQ-zkSDK Compliance Crosswalk Row
description: One control-granular mapping row: what a specific framework control requires, who it binds, what the kit actually provides, what evidence an assessor can inspect, and the honest gap. Consumed by @zksdk/pq-audit report generation. Verb discipline throughout: supports / provides evidence for — never satisfies / complies / certifies.

framework_version.description: Exact instrument/version, e.g. 'CNSA 2.0 FAQ v2.1 (Dec 2024)', 'Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 + CDR (EU) 2024/1774', 'ISO/IEC 27001:2022', 'AICPA TSC 2017 (rev. 2022)'. Frameworks evolve — a row without a pinned version is unreviewable.

control_id.description: Specific control/article/clause, e.g. 'Art. 9(2)', 'CDR 2024/1774 Art. 6', 'Art. 21(2)(h)', 'A.8.24', 'CC6.1'. Never a bare framework name.

applicability.description: Who is actually bound — e.g. 'NSS and NSS vendors only; not commercial entities', 'EU financial entities incl. MiCA-authorized CASPs', 'essential and important entities in Annex I/II sectors, subject to size thresholds and national implementation'. If adopter scope is unknown, reports output not-assessed / out-of-scope-candidate, never an asserted scope.

requirement_summary.description: What the control requires, in one or two sentences, faithful to the instrument's text.

kit_provides.description: What the kit actually contributes toward the entity's obligation. Verbs: supports / provides evidence for.

evidence_artifact.description: The concrete inspectable artifact: a descriptor field, an audit-report section, a CI log, a signed access-trail entry.

gap.description: What the control needs that the kit does not produce (organizational controls, policies, validated modules, auditor judgment). 'none' must be justified — an empty gap claim is itself suspect.

readiness_statement.description: Honest posture summary for the report. Readiness, not requirement; evidence input, not satisfaction.

last_reviewed.description: When this mapping was last checked against the current text of the instrument.
